content: Melvin-Koushki describes MS Majlis 10196 (425 ff., copied 828-41/1425-37 in this passage) as containing 35 major and minor works; its colophons occasionally give both the date of composition and of copying but usually only the date of copying, which then gives only a terminus ad quem for composition. He also reports that ff. 374b-75b hold an interjected fragment from the preface to Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī's Ḥulal-i Muṭarraz.
